title: ChatService injects prompts/tenants/*.md on server
summary: In azure-sdk-qa-bot-agent, server (ChatService._build_tenant_system_message) reads prompts/tenants/*.md and injects it as [skill] on each request, so changes to prompts/tenants/*.md require redeploying server as well as chat_agent.
strategy: Check whether prompts/tenants/*.md or config/ files changed in addition to agents/chat_agent/.
When prompts/tenants/*.md changes, redeploy both chat_agent (pipeline 8159) and server (pipeline 8128) so the preloaded [skill] injected by ChatService is updated.
author: JiaqiZhang-Dev
